string-array.name: municipalities_array
string-array.item: Beijing is the capital city of China, a national‑level municipality. It serves as political and cultural centre, with long history and countless cultural relics including Forbidden City. Many national institutions are located in this metropolis.

Shanghai is China’s economic centre, one of four direct‑controlled municipalities. Located on Yangtze River estuary, it hosts massive international trade, finance industry, modern skyscrapers and rich colonial‑era heritage.
Chongqing is a large inland municipality in southwest China. Surrounded by mountains, it is known as mountain city. It has huge population, important industrial base and rich local folk culture.
Tianjin is a municipality next to Beijing, an important northern port city. It blends modern port economy and historic European‑style old architectures, acting as gateway for capital region.
